charts.title: HD 1397 b: orbits around HD 1397
charts.description: The orbits of HD 1397's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 1397 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Brahm et al. 2019 (2019AJ....158...45B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname BRAHM_ET_AL__2019): P 11.5366 d

charts.title: HD 1397 b: its transit
charts.description: HD 1397 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (96, 103, 104) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 394137592, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 166 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 306 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 34-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 166 min early; 34-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 102 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
